title: MCP allow rules now match exact server names
affects: your settings allow MCP tools with short rules like `mcp__a`.
do: write `mcp__<server>__*` with the full server name, or those tools will start asking for approval.

title: Standalone Claude Design closes
do: move the work you want to keep before Dec 14.

title: Session sharing removed
affects: you shared sessions or saved share links.
do: nothing to rescue, old links already stopped working; use another way to share sessions.

title: `claude ultrareview` needs workspace trust
affects: your scripts or CI run `claude ultrareview` without a terminal.
do: pass `--trust-workspace` after any PR number or base branch, or set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`.

title: `sed -i` edits are no longer undone by `/rewind`
affects: you rely on `/rewind` to undo `sed -i` edits.
do: keep a git commit or a backup before running `sed -i`, since `/rewind` no longer restores those edits.

title: Sandbox hides `~/.docker`, `~/.kube` and `~/_netrc`
affects: your sandboxed commands use Docker registry or Kubernetes cluster credentials.
do: grant those commands explicit access to `~/.docker` or `~/.kube`, or they will be blocked.

title: Guardian v2 defaults to conversation mode
affects: you rely on Codex Guardian's classifications.
do: check what Guardian decides in conversation mode before you depend on it.

title: MCP prompts no longer run shell expressions
affects: you write MCP prompts that use shell expressions.
do: rewrite those prompts to work without shell expressions, since they now stay plain text.

title: Bundled Bun runtime gets security fixes
affects: you run OpenCode older than v1.19.4.
do: update to v1.19.4 or later, which bundles Bun 1.4.4 with fixes for Brotli, TLS and HTTP handling.
